occurrences.englishText: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels;* A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 500 shekels is about 5 kilograms or about 11 pounds. and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;
I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
